additional_info.subject: ID0373174-DC/Si-D/CZ[170001440] - Jaguar iPace cannot charge CRM:00315001677
additional_info.body:
Hello Milan﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R1 170001440
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
t4Yq6t
Problem Description
: Jaguar iPace is not able to charge.
Troubleshooting
:
If the EV is produced pre-2021, then the solution resolves around updating the EV to the latest firmware.
This issue has already been addressed by R&D and consequently closed since Jaguar provided an update to fix this exact issue. Here is an unofficial statement from R&D:
"Please update your vehicle to the latest FW available. This fault is relevant for outdated FW versions and it has been acknowledged by Jaguar; it is consistent for pre-2021 Jaguar iPace models."
This is due to a low isolation fault from the EV side which results in a Rf < 500kOhm.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0373174
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
